svg.title: EH3D-PHOENIX-3DP architecture
svg.desc: EH3D-PHOENIX-3DP is a set of Rust libraries and a command line program for 3D printing: it reads STL, OBJ and 3MF models and the projects other programs save as 3MF, holds a catalog of printer profiles built from public data, slices a closed model into layers with perimeters and infill, writes G-code for four dialects with temperature limits that refuse a value instead of cutting it down, and drives Moonraker and OctoPrint printers and the EH3D server, so far only against simulators and a socket of the same computer. A window with four tabs is written for the gui feature.
